en.search: Ask the assistant or find a field
en.an_auto: Terrasight checks fields automatically every morning. This button runs a check now.
en.neutral: No product ads · open public data: NASA, USDA, ESA and others
en.sub4: One thing can't wait. Three more this week. Five fields are fine.
en.hx1: days the field has been bare
en.hx3: slope — wind and water move the soil
en.acc4: Accept and add to the report
en.cd: goes to the report in 8 s
en.o_q: “How much do we lose if we don't plant corn?”
en.an_usual: Usually takes about a minute. You can leave this page; we will notify you.
en.kn_hostSeasonsInRow: seasons of the same crop in a row
en.kn_hostSeasonsInPlan: of 5 seasons with the same crop if the plan stays
en.kn_lastCropInRow: seasons of the last crop in a row
en.kn_autumnPercentile: of years were cooler than this autumn
en.kn_daysBeforeBpmp: days sown before the recommended date
en.kn_depletionMm: water used from the root zone
en.kn_marginVsCurrent: a year per hectare vs today with the best other option
en.fs_kicker: Stress test · if the weather of {year} repeats in {season}
en.fs_head_better: The recommended plan puts {amount} less at risk than the current plan
en.fs_head_same: The current plan is already the recommended one: {amount} at risk
en.fs_head_worse: In such a year the recommended plan loses {amount} more than the current plan. It is recommended for other reasons: see the field's rotation.
en.fs_of_typical: of {amount} typical margin for that season · {share}
en.fs_skip_no-run: no rotation run yet: open the Plan tab once
en.fs_method: Sum over fields: the margin of season {season} in a typical year minus the margin with {year} weather, times the field area. From the existing rotation runs; no new model.
en.fs_unavailable: Nothing to compute yet: it needs a rotation run on at least one field with prices and {year} weather.
